constraints: Only available for text entry areas, Web areas, and pictures.

params.name: contextMenu
params.description: True to enable the default context menu for the object, False to disable it.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Enables or disables the default context menu association for the designated form object, for the current process.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by '*'.
